algorithm_title: Scan a given paragraph of text and count how many times each individual vowel appears
evidence_summary: This suite provides limited behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with covered normal-path behaviour. Paragraph is fixed; zero-vowel/uppercase-only variants are not exercised by the current frozen suite.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: normal path.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as agreement for the specific exercised scenario or scenarios, not as strong evidence of general behavioural equivalence.
coverage_limitations: Paragraph is fixed; zero-vowel/uppercase-only variants are not exercised by the current frozen suite.

arguments: This is a sentence that contains vowels

semantic_contract.task_statement: Count how many times each vowel appears in a paragraph.
semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

boundary_evaluation_policy.core_score_separation: Boundary probes do not contribute to core semantic behavioural accuracy or Common Test accuracy.
boundary_evaluation_policy.interpretation: If enabled, variance is the percentage of evaluable out-of-domain probes that the implementation accepts and processes.
